note: Neon League items, batch 2 of 5 (DC-N2): the opening pool. A ball, a pin, a ball modification, a pin modification and two Charms, all initial from Division 1, written and landed together by E18-C16. Prism Pin and Spotlight use E18-C14's pin conditions and Grip Tape its hook scale; the others use existing rule pieces. Amounts and prices are provisional (E24).

design.trigger: Thrown with this ball: +5 Mult when the frame is a strike and a roll in it was curved. It hooks as the House Ball does.
design.pool: Shop ball slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A ball that leaves a short light trail only on a charged, curved roll; the Mult shows in the explanation.

design.trigger: When a curved roll knocks it down: +25 Value. Knocked down by a straight roll, or left standing, it gives nothing.
design.pool: Shop pin slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A faceted pin that splits light when a curved ball takes it; it stays dull for a straight one.

design.trigger: Attached to one ball card: every roll thrown with that card hooks 1.4 times as far for the same charge, on top of the ball's own hook. It answers Long Oil and Oil Slick.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 1. One modification per ball.
design.presentation_needs: A badge on the host card and a taped band on the host in play; the aim guide bends further while it is armed.

design.trigger: Attached to one rack position: +3 Mult when its pin is the first one a curved roll's ball knocks down directly. Nothing if another pin is met first, or the roll was straight.
design.pool: Shop modification slot; initial pool from Division 1. One modification per rack position.
design.presentation_needs: A small lamp on the host pin that snaps on when the curved ball reaches it first; the host's own silhouette stays readable.

design.trigger: ×1.5 Mult on a spare when a roll in the frame was curved. Nothing on a strike, an open frame or a straight spare.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A doubled, offset outline of the ball that resolves on a curved spare.

design.trigger: In a frame with no curved roll: +5 Value for each pin knocked down. Any curved roll in the frame gives nothing.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A level's bubble that sits centred and a line that counts the pins of a straight frame.
